verdict.rationale: Bolt gives the AI control of the full environment: filesystem, Node server, package manager, and terminal. It can run Node.js servers and call third-party APIs, projects start from a blank prompt, and backend features (database, email auth, edge functions via Bolt Database or Supabase) are built in, so prompt-driven full-stack generation is clearly supported. Community reports confirm quick idea-to-app builds but note errors when adding a database, and one user says relying on Supabase for the backend caps how far apps can go. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one prompt generates both UI and backend logic together, and hands-on corroboration of reliable backend generation.
